items.title: The category of compactifications of a compactifyable scheme is cofiltered, with the scheme theoretically dense compactifications initial
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.work: Stacks Project, chapter flat.tex (More on Flatness), section 'The local structure of a finite type module'

items.difficulty_reason: The lemma has three parts: cofilteredness of the category of compactifications of a compactifyable X over a quasi-compact quasi-separated S; initiality of the full subcategory of compactifications whose image is dense and scheme theoretically dense; and the statement that a morphism of compactifications f : Xbar' -> Xbar with j'(X) dense in Xbar' satisfies f^{-1}(j(X)) = j'(X) (statement lines 9315-9330). The proof of (a) verifies the three conditions of the definition of a codirected set in the categorical form: a dominating compactification is built as the scheme theoretic image of X under the diagonal map into a fibre product over S (proof lines 9337-9346), and the equalizer of two morphisms between compactifications is shown to be a closed subscheme of the source, hence proper over S, using only separatedness of the target (proof lines 9347-9357). Part (b) replaces a compactification by the scheme theoretic closure of X inside it, and part (c) reduces to a scheme theoretic image statement for a partial section by replacing Xbar' with the closure of j'(X) (proof lines 9360-9377). The construction of the dominating compactification and the equalizer argument are the non-formal steps, so the claim is H2.
